channel_id_map.note: CHIME freq_id f is centred at 800 MHz - f * 390625 Hz, and this profile's coarse_channel_index i at 800 MHz - (i + 1) * 390625 Hz, so freq_id = coarse_channel_index + 1. Populates chime_channel_id / receiver_channel_id in exported runtime bundles.

channelizer_frequency_axis.channel_index_to_rf_hz: rf_hz = upper_hz - (coarse_channel_index + 1) * coarse_channel_width_hz, with coarse_channel_width_hz = bandwidth_hz / num_coarse_channels = 390625 Hz
channelizer_frequency_axis.verified_note: frame + sense verified against measured pilot ensemble, 2026-07-29

baseband_frame.note: Pilot transmitter ensemble measured within +-1.3 kHz of nominal ATSC pilot under center-at-DC framing; legacy center-at-Nyquist (+0.5) assumption disconfirmed on this data lineage. channel_center_normalized_odd_channels is available if a per-parity PFB decimation twiddle is ever demonstrated; parity is defined on this profile's coarse_channel_index convention (index = CHIME freq_id - 1).
